dataset_note: Harbor tasks sync as Langfuse traces under sessionId=harbor_job_id (not a LangSmith dataset).

session.meaning: One Langfuse session per Harbor job; trials are traces in that session

reward.meaning: Primary Harbor trial score (0|1) posted as Langfuse score name `reward`

harbor_error.meaning: Optional future score when trial raised; prefer fix Portage over soft-fail
